title: An open benchmark and language models for AI in aging biology
description: Insilico Medicine researchers tested 18 leading AI models on LongevityBench, 17 aging-biology tasks built from real clinical, DNA-methylation, gene-expression and blood-protein data. No general model won outright, and small models trained on aging data (0.6B-9B parameters) took the top three spots. Benchmark, models and tools are open.
